description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM leave module. The class extends a date range filter class, allows setting filtering parameters such as employee number and report type, and includes validation for report type values.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering employee leave entitlement and usage reports, supporting filtering by employee number and report type, with validation for report type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter, nullable integer.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportType
methods.description: Returns the current report type filter value.

methods.name: setReportType
methods.description: Validates and sets the report type filter parameter; throws exception if invalid.
